materials.sand_note: the OPCD base project ships GSPsand (no TVGsand asset); GSPro maps it to its sand physics

name_rules_note: first match wins on the lower-cased collider (or parent) name; order matters: rough_outer and deep before rough, b_rough_fairway / b_fairway before blend (a blend strip is B_<outer>_<inner>_-_Blend: green, tee and fairway blends play as their inner surface as the scene already has them, bunker and water blends play as the outer surface, rough), rock/wall before water, fence/post = GSPtimber as BuildFences sets them; nets by part name only (netpanel, netting, netpost, netpole), never the bare token 'net' (2026-11-03 audit: 2,694 fence posts, 76 outer rough, 8 waterfall rocks and 49 deep-rough ground pieces under the NETS group would have been flipped by earlier tables)

census.scope: every SVG polygon class plus a 10 m margin
census.note: top collider at each grid point vs the SVG class; collar and first-cut rings may differ legitimately within 4 m of a green or tee
census.overlays_note: the SVG rough/deep classes are the fallback ground; cart paths, shrub chunks, rocks, fences and the outer deep rough are not SVG classes and legitimately sit on them, so these materials count as 'overlay', not mismatch
census.edge_name_tokens_note: a blend strip straddles the outline by design and a collar patch (GSPfairway by greens.tiers) has no SVG class; their points are 'edge', not failed, whatever side of the line they fall

auto_fix.allowed_when: name rule matched and no conflicting SVG class under the mesh centroid
never: colliders under LODGroup (trees: canopy/trunk set by the tree tools)
any collider whose name matches no rule

report: AutomationOutput/checks/physics_audit.csv (collider, current, expected, action, x, z), physics_census.csv, physics_unsure.csv

actions.fix: name rule matched, material differs, asset exists
actions.fix(missing): no material at all, rule matched
actions.missing-asset: rule matched but the physic material asset is not in the project
actions.unmatched: no rule for the name but it carries a material: glance, usually fine
actions.unsure: no rule and NO material: hand-label in the Inspector
actions.review: name rule says a structure (timber/stone/leaves/wood/concrete/water) but the collider carries a ground material: a ground piece under a structure's parent, decide by hand

audit.review_when: the collider carries a ground material and its name rule says a structure class: report 'review', never auto-fix (a ground piece grouped under a structure's parent)
